## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass
- [ ] Route or schema change: `npm run gen:openapi` run and `openapi.json` / `openapi.surface.json` committed
- [ ] Contract or lexicon change: `CHANGELOG.md` updated (see `specs/api-versioning.md` for what counts as breaking)
- [ ] No migration that has already been applied was edited
